candidate_edge: One pre-open-range breakout per weekday on XAUUSD anchored to 08:30 America/New_York (server time = New York + 7 h, constant): reference range = the four closed M15 bars before the anchor; first M15 bar in [anchor, anchor+60 min) CLOSING beyond the range triggers; entry at the next bar open, stop = range width W, frozen target arms A15 = 1.5 W / A20 = 2.0 W, floor / cap 0.85-2.19 x ATR(14,H1), flat at 16:00 America/New_York, DD kill bar 20R. PRESCREEN OUTCOME: FALSIFIED on the selection period (E[R] -0.050 R, PF 0.91, worst-year DD 27.8R) and the measured FTMO spread (0.44 USD = 0.087R at the median range) exceeds any plausible expectancy; RETIRE recommended.
confidence: High that the frozen mechanism has no net expectancy on 2018-2022 .DWX history and that the FTMO spread makes it uneconomic in every period (n=682 SEL / 447 VAL). The spread figure is a 2026 venue harvest applied to 2018-2025 ranges, stated as such, not assumed; the news blackout would further cut density.
confounders: Zero spread in .DWX history; the FTMO spread sensitivity uses a 2026 harvest (100,000 M1 rows) against 2018-2025 range widths: the ratio is indicative, the direction is not in doubt.
News blackout not modelled: the 08:30 NY releases sit inside the entry window, so the framework filter would remove a large share of the fires (density upper bound).
Conservative same-bar stop-first resolution on M1 bars; no slippage modelled.
Floor/cap thresholds derived on the selection period only; validation applies them unchanged.
Dependence with 10700 (demo roster gold sleeve) not evaluated (moot after falsification).
observations: Prescreen 2018-07-02..2025-12-31 (1,932 trading days): 1,129 breakout trades, 373 no-signal days, 271 floor- and 158 cap-excluded days. SEL A15 n=682, 0.58/bd, E[R] -0.050, PF 0.91, worst-year DD 27.8R; A20 -0.046 / 0.92 / 29.1R. VAL A15 n=447, 0.57/bd, +0.038, PF 1.07, DD 19.7R; A20 +0.030 / 1.05. Per-year A15: 2018 +3.6, 2019 -21.5, 2020 -18.0, 2021 +6.6, 2022 -5.1, 2023 +9.3, 2024 -10.2, 2025 +18.0. Commission median 0.018R (p90 0.028R). Measured FTMO XAUUSD spread median 44 points (0.44 USD) = 0.087R at the SEL median width (5.05 USD) and 0.067R at the VAL median width (6.53 USD). Frozen-screen comparators unchanged: 10423 0.82/bd +0.086R (Q05 FAIL dd 41%), 11690 1.84/bd +0.028R (dd 59%), 10700 0.18/bd +0.165R 58% overnight.
proposed_mechanism: Session-gated redesign of the always-on XAUUSD H1 edge (10423 / 11690) as a single pre-open-range breakout at the 08:30 NY macro time, flat before the close. Revision 2 measured it directly: density 0.58 trades/bd is present, expectancy is not; the 60-minute pre-open range (median 5.05 USD) is too small relative to commission and, above all, to the measured FTMO spread.
